title: Multi-Store Management
description: Learn how to create and manage multiple stores from a single Tijraa account.
content:
Multi-Store Management

Tijraa allows you to create and manage unlimited stores from a single account. Each store operates independently with its own products, orders, customers, and settings.

Benefits of Multiple Stores

  • Brand Separation: Manage different brands separately
  • Market Segmentation: Target different customer segments
  • Product Organization: Separate product catalogs
  • Geographic Expansion: Different stores for different regions
  • Business Growth: Scale your business easily

Creating Additional Stores

To create a new store:

  1. Navigate to Stores in the sidebar
  2. Click Create Store or New Store
  3. Fill in store information:
    • Store name
    • Store slug
    • Description
    • Theme
    • Logo
  4. Configure initial settings
  5. Click Save

Store Switching

Switch between stores easily:

From Dashboard

  • Use the store switcher in the header
  • Select the store you want to manage
  • All sections update to that store

From Stores Page

  • View all your stores in a list
  • Click on any store to manage it
  • Switch context immediately

Store Isolation

Each store is completely independent:

  • Products: Separate product catalogs
  • Orders: Independent order management
  • Customers: Separate customer databases
  • Settings: Individual store configurations
  • Payment: Separate payment gateways
  • Shipping: Different shipping methods

Managing Multiple Stores

Store Dashboard

Each store has its own dashboard showing:

  • Store-specific metrics
  • Recent orders
  • Top products
  • Revenue statistics

Store Settings

Configure each store independently:

  • Store information
  • Contact details
  • Theme and branding
  • Payment methods
  • Shipping methods

Store Status Management

Control each store's availability:

  • Active: Store is live
  • Inactive: Store is hidden
  • Maintenance: Show maintenance message

Store Analytics

View analytics for:

  • Individual stores
  • All stores combined
  • Compare performance

Store Limits

Store limits depend on your subscription plan:

  • Free Plan: Limited stores
  • Basic Plan: Multiple stores
  • Professional Plan: Unlimited stores
  • Enterprise Plan: Unlimited stores

Best Practices

  • Use clear, distinct names for each store
  • Organize stores by brand or market
  • Keep store settings consistent where possible
  • Monitor each store's performance separately
  • Use appropriate themes for each store type

Deleting Stores

To delete a store:

  1. Go to the store settings
  2. Click Delete Store
  3. Confirm deletion

Warning: Deleting a store permanently removes all associated data including products, orders, and customers. This action cannot be undone.

Next Steps

After creating multiple stores:

  • Learn more about store creation
  • Configure store settings
